clips.title: The story
paras: Dreadmaul Post is an entrenched ogre settlement situated in the scorched wastes of the Blasted Lands. Established by the Dreadmaul clan, this mound serves as a fortified redoubt near the Dark Portal where ogres have lingered since their arrival from Draenor. Travelers passing through the region must contend with these fierce brutes and the treacherous terrain surrounding their encampment.

When the Horde surged through the Dark Portal in decades past, clans of ogres marched alongside them into Azeroth. The Dreadmaul clan chose to dig in near the gateway itself, raising crude stone mounds and earthworks across the red wastes of the Blasted Lands. Dreadmaul Post stands as one of their primary outposts, maintaining a firm grip over the badlands and clashing with wandering beasts and any travelers foolish enough to draw near their territory.
